# Pariter

> Pariter is an RICS-regulated chartered surveying and consultancy practice based in
> Manchester, England. It advises public and private sector clients across Greater
> Manchester and the North West on party wall matters, expert witness work, property
> and estates, project management and strategic consultancy.

## Key facts

- Legal name: Pariter Ltd, registered in England & Wales, company number 05308864
- Office: Colony 5 Piccadilly Place, Manchester M1 3BR, United Kingdom
- Telephone: 0161 706 1147
- Regulation: RICS (Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors) regulated firm
- Areas served: Manchester, Greater Manchester, North West England
- Website: https://pariter.ltd

## Services

- [Party Wall Surveyor Manchester](https://pariter.ltd/party-wall-surveyor-manchester): Notices, Schedules of Condition and Awards under the Party Wall etc. Act 1996 for building owners, adjoining owners, architects, developers and contractors.
- [Party Wall Matters](https://pariter.ltd/party-wall-matters): Explanation of the Party Wall etc. Act 1996 for commercial and residential clients, including when notice is required and who pays.
- [Expert Witness Services](https://pariter.ltd/expert-witness-services): Independent expert reports and evidence for courts and tribunals on building defects, dilapidations, boundaries, valuation and professional negligence.
- [Legal Surveying & Dispute Resolution](https://pariter.ltd/legal-surveying-dispute-resolution): Surveyor advocacy in property, construction and land disputes, including tribunal and public inquiry representation.
- [Property Services](https://pariter.ltd/property-services): Strategic estates reviews, acquisitions and disposals, valuations and professional property management.
- [Project Management](https://pariter.ltd/project-management): Project and programme management across healthcare, construction, public and private sector schemes.
- [Consultancy Services](https://pariter.ltd/consultancy-services): Organisational and departmental reviews, procurement support and securing capital investment.

## Other pages

- [Contact](https://pariter.ltd/contact): Office address, telephone number and enquiry form.
- [Policies](https://pariter.ltd/policies): Privacy notice, cookie policy, complaints handling, code of ethics, anti-bribery, equality and modern slavery statements.

## Notes

- Pariter does not publish fee scales online; fees depend on the property, the matter and its complexity.
- Party Wall compliance is separate from planning permission and Building Regulations approval.
- The Party Wall etc. Act 1996 applies in England and Wales only.
